name: Advanced Semiconductor Optoelectronic Devices - Physics, Design, Growth and & Characterization
description: Fundamentals of III–V semiconductors—crystal structures (zincblende, wurtzite), direct/indirect band gaps, lattice constants, strain and band-engineering; epitaxial growth—MBE, MOCVD, layer design, lattice matching, strain relaxation, defects; quantum wells, wires, dots—band offsets, quantum confinement, density of states, k·p calculation; radiative transitions—spontaneous emission, internal/external quantum efficiency, carrier transport; semiconductor lasers—stimulated emission, optical gain, threshold condition, cavity design, quantum-well, DFB/DBR, QCLs, VCSELs; device design—doping profiles, electrical injection, optical confinement, thermal management; advanced topics—nitride LEDs/lasers, perovskites, reliability, packaging.
